data.narrative:
Precision Neuroscience is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $180M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies (Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit) and 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $180M capital raised proxy, implying a $306M valuation. Peer-median analysis anchors to the median valuation of 3 Series C biotech peers at $3.8B, with a range from $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue for the private target. The median of these two methods yields $2.1B; the full triangulated range is $260M (low) to $4.4B (high), with $306M and $3.8B representing the point estimates from each method.

The wide dispersion between stage-progression ($306M) and peer-median ($3.8B) reflects material uncertainty about Precision Neuroscience's relative standing within the peer cohort. The peer group includes substantial outliers—Colossal at $10.3B—suggesting heterogeneity in stage readiness, technology risk, or investor conviction. Without additional data on revenue traction, IP strength, or capital efficiency relative to peers, the median estimate of $2.1B should be treated as a statistical anchor rather than a point target. Key uncertainties include clinical-stage milestones and competitive positioning within the neuroscience subsector.
